Seems like they can’t tell their ass from their elbow over at [Location] and the place is a mess. I need help collecting supplies spread across the outpost and putting them where they’re supposed to go. Here are the specifics:

Pick up package #[Item1] at [Location].
Pick up package #[Item4] at [Location].
Pick up package #[Item5] at [Location1].
Pick up package #[Item2] at [Location1].
Pick up package #[Item3] at [Location2].
  
All of the above need to end up at [Destination]. Easy and low-risk work, if you’re interested.

A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
